question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-10) + (-3) × 7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS rule to resolve the expression based on priority.

D: (−60) ÷ (−10) = 6

M: (−3) × 7 = −21

Expression becomes: −9 − 6 − 21

Calculate sum: −15 − 21 = −36

**∴ The correct answer is −36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−3) × 7

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule (Bracket, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Given expression: (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−3) × 7

⇒ Step 1 (Division): (−60) ÷ (−10) = 6

⇒ Expression becomes: (−9) − 6 + (−3) × 7

⇒ Step 2 (Multiplication): (−3) × 7 = −21

⇒ Expression becomes: (−9) − 6 + (−21)

⇒ Step 3 (Addition & Subtraction): −9 − 6 − 21

⇒ −15 − 21 = −36

**∴ The correct answer is −36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It dictates the sequence of operations: Brackets, Order (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. Multiplications and divisions have the same priority and are calculated from left to right, as are addition and subtraction.

Rules of Signs in Multiplication & Division

Positive × Positive = Positive | Negative × Negative = Positive | Positive × Negative = Negative | Negative × Positive = Negative.

Rules of Signs in Addition & Subtraction

When subtracting a negative number, it turns into addition (−(−x) = +x). When adding two negative numbers, add their absolute values and retain the negative sign.
